decision.rationale: In the audited seed-42 development readout, mean HR@10 was 0.5815 for the candidate, 0.58925 for the generated control, and 0.59525 for the incumbent. The candidate trailed both in all four categories and was ineligible for confirmation. Host checks support completed execution, but do not establish the proposed mechanism.
unresolved_explanations: The proposed fixed-state, nonzero-gain formula contrast, zero-gain incumbent equality, distinct behavior after an update, and post-update scoring identity are not supplied as verified diagnostic results.
Matched parameter counts do not isolate feature calibration from differences in source tensors or optimization. Initialization and checkpoint selection may also affect this single-seed result.
Exploratory history slices include positive and null results, but lack a control-by-history contrast; sparse long-history bins limit interpretation.
